summary_en: 81,000 shares (1.12% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at ¥149.77M upper limit; execution window 08:45 JST same-day; results to be published post-trade.
title_en: Notice of Own Share Acquisition via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Toyo Wharf & Warehouse filed a notice on 2026-07-31 of an off-hours block acquisition of its own shares scheduled for 2026-08-03 at 08:45 JST via ToSTNeT-3 trading. The board on 2026-07-31 authorized the acquisition of up to 82,000 shares (1.14% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥150M over the window 2026-08-03 to 2026-12-31. Today's announcement narrows the execution to a single ToSTNeT-3 block: precisely 81,000 shares at an upper limit of ¥149.77M, with the closing price of ¥1,849 as the reference. The order is time-limited to the single 08:45 trading session; partial or non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be published immediately after the trade concludes. The disclosed ceiling price of ¥1,849 equals the 2026-07-31 closing price and implies no price ceiling premium above that close.
